fol.notes: Being rational (a fraction p/q) is the model's belief: uninterpreted predicates, since built-in reals cannot make √2 rational. q1 asks about a fraction whose square is 2; the only numbers whose square is 2 are ±√2, and the question is read as being about √2 (sqrt_sq). q2's ratio is diag_ratio, equal to √2 by the stored fact about squares. Delete: nothing places √2 among the rationals or irrationals afterwards.

rat_frac.says: Every rational number can be written as a fraction p/q of two whole numbers (and every such fraction is rational).

irr_def.says: An irrational number is a number that is not rational.

sqrt_sq.says: The square of the square root of 2 is 2.

diag.says: The diagonal of a square is the square root of 2 times its side, so diagonal : side = √2.
